values.title: Values of {field}
values.chooseIntro: Choose a field to see every text it holds across your items and media, and move a text to the field it belongs in.
values.noneInUse: No item type has fields yet. Find a field below.
values.findOtherHint: Describe it, for example “where it was made”
values.intro: Every text this field holds, on items, item sets and media, most used first. Drag a value to another field, or use “Move to”, and it moves on every record that holds it.
values.empty: No record has a value in {field} yet.
values.dropHere: Drop values here to move them to {field}.
values.chosen: {count} values chosen. Drag one of them, or use “Move to” on one, to move them all.
values.merged: {count} of them already hold it under {to}; they only lose it from {from}.
values.skipped: {count} records you cannot change keep it under {from}.
values.nothing: Nothing to move: no record you can change holds “{value}” under {from}.
values.notInForm: {to} is not one of the fields of {type}: {count} of these records will hold a value its form does not show.
values.undoNote: Undo puts back the last move made on this visit. The History of each item lists every move.
